title: Impactful Film for National Competition on ODF Plus Model Village
excerpt: Megh Foundation volunteers created and submitted a national-level awareness film showcasing the ODF Plus model for sanitation, hygiene, and community health.
coverImageAlt: Community sanitation awareness activity for ODF Plus model
bodyMarkdown:
## Story overview

Megh Foundation volunteers produced a film for the Ministry of Jal Shakti's National Film Competition on the theme **ODF Plus Model Village**. The film focused on how communities can move beyond open-defecation-free status toward long-term hygiene and health systems.

## What the film highlighted

- Sustainable solid and liquid waste management
- Hygiene practices such as handwashing and safe water use
- Community participation to maintain public sanitation outcomes

## Production journey

The team developed the concept, script, and field narrative around real examples from model villages. Interviews, local visuals, and practical outcomes were used to make the message relatable and actionable for other communities.

## Why this matters

The project demonstrates Megh Foundation's approach: combine youth-led communication with civic outcomes so behavior change becomes community-owned and sustainable.
